title: 4Ps & 7Ps Marketing Mix
prompt:
I PROMPT — COPY & PASTE READY
Act as a marketing strategist using the 7Ps Marketing Mix.
My business        :  [DESCRIBE YOUR PRODUCT OR SERVICE]
Target customer :  [WHO THEY ARE AND WHAT THEY VALUE]
Current stage      :  [EARLY / GROWING / SCALING]
Analyse and recommend for all 7Ps:
PRODUCT       :  What are we selling,  features and positioning
PRICE              :  How should we price, value, cost, or competitive?
PLACE             :  Where and how do customers access us?
PROMOTION  :  Which channels and messages drive awareness?
PEOPLE           :  Who delivers the experience. skills and culture
PROCESS         :  How is the service or product delivered?
PHYSICAL       :  What tangible evidence builds trust?
Flag any contradictions between elements. Identify the 2 Ps that most need improvement.
For those 2 Ps, give one specific change I should make in the next 30 days.
